question.text: What share of the vote will Vox win in Spain's November 29, 2026 general election?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as the share of valid votes cast nationwide for Vox candidacies, including any coalition in which Vox is the lead partner, in the November 29, 2026 election to the Congress of Deputies, in percent to one decimal place, per the proclaimed results published by the Junta Electoral Central, the Ministry of the Interior or [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions), after any recounts.
question.fine_print:
Valid votes include blank ballots, following the Ministry of the Interior's standard presentation.

***
This question's information (resolution criteria, fine print, background info, etc) is synced with an [original identical question](https://www.metaculus.com/questions/46266) which opened on 2026-10-26 17:00:00. This question will resolve based on the resolution criteria and fine print of the linked original question. However, if this question would resolve differently than the original question, then this question will be annulled. Additionally, if the original question's resolution could have been known before this question opened, then this question will be annulled.

## Vox vote share, Spanish general election of 29 November 2026: research briefing

### 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on the official, proclaimed nationwide Congress results from the Junta Electoral Central or the Ministry of the Interior (resultados.elecciones.gob.es). Blank ballots count as valid votes. There is no result yet because the vote is on 2026-11-29. I did not fetch an Interior results file because none exists before election night.
- 2023-07-23 (reference): Vox won 12.4% of valid votes ([Wikipedia 2023](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023_Spanish_general_election)).

### 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet. The election is 26 days away. Candidate lists appeared in the BOE on 2026-10-28 ([La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/andalucia/cordoba/doce-candidaturas-disputan-seis-escanos-cordoba-generales-29n_202611026ae818f3004b78127abccd60.html)).

### 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-03: Vox asked the JEC to order real-time publication of mail-vote data ([La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/vox-pide-junta-electoral-que-haga-publicos-datos-voto-correo-que-moncloa-recibe-tiempo-real_202611036ae9d84fb55c427e2ebd5f33.html)).
- 2026-11-01/03: Sondaxe for La Voz de Galicia, fieldwork 26-28 Oct: PP 29.2, PSOE 26.9, Vox 19.2. Vox is the party growing fastest ([Democrata](https://www.democrata.es/en/politics/sondaxe-survey-pp-leads-psoe-by-23-points-and-vox-reaches-192-one-month-before-the-elections/), [Infobae](https://www.infobae.com/espana/2026/11/03/el-pp-ganaria-las-elecciones-con-23-puntos-de-ventaja-sobre-el-psoe-y-vox-seria-la-fuerza-que-mas-crece-segun-la-ultima-encuesta-antes-del-accidente-de-trenes-en-toledo/)).
- 2026-11-01: A Vox internal poll reported by The Objective puts Vox at 20.2% and 67-71 seats. It is a partisan poll, so treat it with caution ([The Objective](https://theobjective.com/espana/2026-11-01/sondeo-vox-71-escanos/)).
- 2026-11-01/02: SocioMétrica for El Español: PP 32.7, PSOE 26.6, Vox 19.1. It gives PP and Vox a 72% chance of a three-fifths Senate majority ([El Español](https://www.elespanol.com/espana/politica/20261102/tragedia-urda-pp-vox-hoy-opciones-lograr-mayoria-quintos-senado/1003744443526_0.html)).
- 2026-10-28 to 30, after the Urda train crash (69 dead): Target Point has Vox up from 18.7 to 19.9 and 72 seats ([Democrata](https://www.democrata.es/encuestas/elecciones-generales/encuesta-target-point-urda-vox-72-escanos-psoe-29n/)). Sigma Dos has Vox at 19.3 and says PSOE has been hurt ([TRT](https://www.trthaber.com/haber/dunya/ispanyadaki-tren-kazasi-erken-genel-secim-oncesi-anketlerde-sosyalistlerin-oyunu-dusurdu-961940.html)).
- 2026-11-02: CIS microdata show Vox ahead of PP among voters aged 18-24 ([20minutos](https://www.20minutos.es/nacional/que-partidos-votan-mas-jovenes-asi-evolucionado-apoyo-politico-elecciones-2023_7056171_0.html)).
- 2026-10-05: Sánchez called the snap election after his housing decrees failed.

**Polls from late October to 1 November, Vox share** ([Wikipedia polling page](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Opinion_polling_for_the_2026_Spanish_general_election)):

| Pollster | Vox % |
|---|---|
| SocioMétrica | 19.1 |
| Sigma Dos | 19.3 |
| Target Point | 19.9 |
| EM-Analytics | 19.2 |
| NC Report | 19.3 |
| Sondaxe | 19.2 |
| Hamalgama | 19.9 |
| The Objective | 20.2 |
| PSOE internal | 20.0 |

- The median of these is about 19.3%. Across all published polls the range is 18.2% (GAD3, early Oct) to 20.2%.
- Early-October polls mostly showed 18-19%, so there is a small upward drift of about 0.5 to 1 point.
- The October CIS barometer reportedly has Vox at 17.1% (PSOE 34.0, PP 22.2). The CIS has historically been an outlier in PSOE's favour. I could not find the CIS pre-election study for 29N ([casasdeapuestas](https://www.casasdeapuestas.com/noticias/cis-apuestas-elecciones-generales-29n/)).

### 4. Base rates
- **Vox's past general-election results:** 0.2% (2015 and 2016), 10.3% (April 2019), 15.1% (November 2019), 12.4% (2023).
- **How far final polls missed Vox in past elections.** These figures are approximate and from memory, not checked this session:
  - 2023: polls averaged about 13-14%, Vox got 12.4%. Polls overestimated Vox by about 1-1.5 points.
  - November 2019: polls were around 13.5-14.5%, Vox got 15.1%. Polls underestimated Vox by about 1 point or more.
  - April 2019: polls were around 11-12%, Vox got 10.3%. Polls overestimated Vox.
  - So the miss has gone both ways, typically by 1-2 points.
- **Movement during a campaign:** in past campaigns the poll average for Vox has moved roughly 1-2 points over the final month.
- **Recent regional elections:** Vox scored about 17-19% in Extremadura (December 2025), Aragón and Castilla y León (early 2026). These are also from memory and not verified this session.

### 5. Other forecasts
Market prices were fetched 2026-11-03 at 18:08 UTC.

**Kalshi, Vox vote percent (chance of "at least" each level):**

| Vox share | Yes price |
|---|---|
| ≥16% | 0.94 |
| ≥17% | 0.81 |
| ≥18% | 0.64 |
| ≥19% | 0.51 |
| ≥20% | 0.33 |
| ≥21% | 0.18 |
| ≥22% | 0.10 |

- The implied median is about 19.0%.
- These contracts look like they match this question, but check whether Kalshi counts blank votes as valid, as the question does.

**Polymarket, Vox % of vote (range buckets):**

| Range | Yes price |
|---|---|
| <16% | 0.01 |
| 16-18% | 0.32 |
| 18-20% | 0.40 |
| 20-22% | 0.215 |
| 22%+ | 0.065 |

- The implied median is about 18.8-19%.

**Related markets:**
- PP and Vox together reaching 50% or more: 0.45 on Kalshi, 0.455 on Polymarket.
- Vox seats: the Kalshi median is about 66-67. The Polymarket mode is 66-70.

I found no Manifold market and no published Metaculus community value.

### 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Official campaign period, roughly 13-27 November. Expect televised debates.
- Polls can be published until the legal ban starts five days before the vote, around 23-24 November. The CIS pre-election macro-survey is expected in mid-November.
- Further fallout from the Urda crash. Early polls suggest it hurts PSOE and helps PP and Vox.
- Mail voting is running now, and Vox is disputing how the data is reported.
- 2026-11-29: election day, with Interior's provisional count that night. The JEC proclamation follows in December, before the question resolves around 2026-12-31. Recounts usually change shares by less than 0.1 point.

**Sources:** [Wikipedia polling](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Opinion_polling_for_the_2026_Spanish_general_election), [Infobae 27 Oct](https://www.infobae.com/espana/2026/10/27/asi-estan-las-encuestas-para-el-29-de-noviembre-pp-y-vox-mantienen-la-mayoria-absoluta-el-psoe-gana-terreno-y-la-izquierda-fragmentada-no-logra-remontar/), [El Debate](https://www.eldebate.com/espana/comunidad-valenciana/20261029/encuestas-electorales-29n-resultados-pp-psoe-vox-compromis-provincias-grandes-ciudades_474910.html), [Ara](https://es.ara.cat/politica/dicen-encuestas-elecciones-espanolas-29-n_1_5874092.html), [Maldita 2019 CIS](https://maldita.es/malditodato/el-cis-falla-todas-las-estimaciones-de-escanos-de-los-6-principales-partidos-para-estas-elecciones-generales/), plus the links above.

# Vox vote share in Spain's 29 November 2026 general election: research notes

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-03: The question resolves on the proclaimed results for the Congress of Deputies published by the Junta Electoral Central or the Ministry of the Interior (resultados.elecciones / infoelectoral). Vote shares count blank ballots in the denominator. The vote is on 2026-11-29, so no result exists yet. I did not fetch an Interior page because it has no data for this election.
- 2026-10-28: The BOE published the official candidacy lists. In Córdoba, for example, 12 candidacies are standing for 6 seats. [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/andalucia/cordoba/doce-candidaturas-disputan-seis-escanos-cordoba-generales-29n_202611026ae818f3004b78127abccd60.html)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question. The election is 26 days away. Sánchez called the early election on 2026-10-05, after his housing decrees failed. [20minutos](https://www.20minutos.es/nacional/quien-ganara-elecciones-29-noviembre-segun-encuestas-sondeos_7044112_0.html)
- 2026-10-28: The Urda (Toledo) train crash killed 69 people. Polls taken since then show PSOE slipping and Vox flat or slightly up. [democrata.es](https://www.democrata.es/encuestas/elecciones-generales/encuesta-target-point-urda-vox-72-escanos-psoe-29n/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-03: Vox asked the JEC to make the government publish mail-in voting data in real time. [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/espana/vox-pide-junta-electoral-que-haga-publicos-datos-voto-correo-que-moncloa-recibe-tiempo-real_202611036ae9d84fb55c427e2ebd5f33.html)
- 2026-11-01: SocioMétrica for El Español: PP 32.7, PSOE 26.6, Vox 19.1. [laSexta](https://www.lasexta.com/elecciones/generales/encuestas-sondeos-29n-2026_202611036ae9889d025012321571f583.html), [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Opinion_polling_for_the_2026_Spanish_general_election)
- 2026-11-01: An internal Vox poll reported by The Objective puts Vox at 20.2% and 67-71 seats. This is a party poll. [The Objective](https://theobjective.com/espana/2026-11-01/sondeo-vox-71-escanos/)
- 2026-10-29/30: Polls with fieldwork in this window:
  - Sigma Dos for El Mundo: Vox 19.3, PSOE 24.6
  - Target Point for El Debate: Vox 19.9, up from 18.7; PP 31.8
  - EM-Analytics: Vox 19.2
  - NC Report for La Razón (fieldwork 26-29 Oct): Vox 19.3

  [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Opinion_polling_for_the_2026_Spanish_general_election), [democrata.es](https://www.democrata.es/encuestas/elecciones-generales/encuesta-target-point-urda-vox-72-escanos-psoe-29n/)
- 2026-10-26/28: Sondaxe: PP 29.2, PSOE 26.9, Vox 19.2. Hamalgama (22-28 Oct): Vox 19.9. [Infobae](https://www.infobae.com/espana/2026/11/03/el-pp-ganaria-las-elecciones-con-23-puntos-de-ventaja-sobre-el-psoe-y-vox-seria-la-fuerza-que-mas-crece-segun-la-ultima-encuesta-antes-del-accidente-de-trenes-en-toledo/)
- Other October polls put Vox at:
  - IMOP (13-16 Oct): 20.0
  - Ateneo del Dato: 19.8
  - Winston: 19.2
  - 40dB/Prisa (7-8 Oct): 18.9
  - GAD3 (6-8 Oct): 18.2, the lowest major figure
  - GESOP: 18.9

  The 40dB poll of 25-28 Sept had Vox at 18.4. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Opinion_polling_for_the_2026_Spanish_general_election), [Ara](https://en.ara.cat/politics/what-do-the-polls-for-the-spanish-elections-of-november-29-say_1_5874100.html)

## 4. Base rates
- Past Vox results: 0.2% (2015 and 2016), 10.3% (April 2019), 15.1% (November 2019), 12.4% (2023).
- Current polling: polls taken in late October have Vox in a tight 19.1-20.2% band, with a rough median of about 19.3. The trend over October is flat to slightly rising, from about 18.2-19.6 in early October to 19.1-19.9.
- Past polling error for Vox, from memory and approximate, so worth checking:
  - 2023: final poll averages had Vox at about 13-14%. It won 12.4%, an overestimate of about 1-1.5 points.
  - November 2019: final averages had about 13.5-14%. It won 15.1%, an underestimate of about 1-1.5 points.
  - April 2019: polls had about 11-12%. It won 10.3%, an overestimate.
- So final-poll errors of ±1-2 points in either direction are typical. Shifts of about 1-2 points during the campaign are also common.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- More fallout from the Urda crash and any official findings on who is responsible.
- The official campaign, which normally starts about 15 days before polling day, so around 2026-11-13, along with televised debates.
- A CIS pre-election survey, likely in mid-November.
- Spain bans publishing polls in the 5 days before the vote, so the last published polls will come out around 2026-11-23.
- Mail-in voting controversy: Vox's complaint to the JEC.
- Election day is 2026-11-29. The provisional count comes that night, and the JEC proclaims the official results in December.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) **Time left:** 26 days until the 29 November 2026 vote. The provisional count comes that night, and the official proclamation follows in December.

(b) **Latest known value from the resolution source:** Vox won 12.4% in the 23 July 2023 general election. The current polling median is about 19.3%, with a late-October range of 19.1 to 20.2%. The CIS is the outlier, with Vox at 17.1%.

(c) **If nothing changed:** about 19.2 to 19.3%, in line with the poll median.
